subject.title: Inconsistent message:sent / message_sent hook coverage across multiple outbound dispatch paths

question: Should the remaining outbound lifecycle gaps be solved by a shared exactly-once observer/reporting seam, or should this umbrella be closed only after maintainers split and own narrower channel/API fixes?
rationale: Both paths are plausible, but the choice affects plugin SDK surface, security-sensitive audit semantics, streaming rewrite/cancel behavior, and channel ownership boundaries.

options.title: Keep Canonical Umbrella And Define Contract
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define the canonical exactly-once outbound lifecycle contract and review narrow PRs against it.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Canonical Issues
options.body: Move each remaining surface such as WebChat/TUI, native self-delivery, and Teams into separate canonical issues, then close this umbrella only after the links preserve the original context.

options.title: Land Per-Channel Fixes Opportunistically
options.body: Accept targeted channel fixes without a shared contract, trading faster local repairs for continued risk of hook drift and double-firing.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical Umbrella And Define Contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define the canonical exactly-once outbound lifecycle contract and review narrow PRs against it.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision crosses gateway/TUI, outbound, plugin SDK, and channel ownership; path history points to steipete as the broadest current routing candidate.
